reason_codes.implemented-semantic-rule: Exact provider construct has an accepted semantic rule.
reason_codes.implemented-detail-rule: Exact provider construct is retained as architecture detail, not promoted to an independent service node.
reason_codes.bounded-azapi-discriminator: Generic AzAPI input is supported only through admitted exact ARM type and API-version predicates.
reason_codes.admitted-azapi-arm-type: Dated ARM type and API version has an exact static AzAPI rule.
reason_codes.configuration-or-helper: Provider declaration configures or supports another service and has no independent architecture identity.
reason_codes.reviewed-no-independent-architecture-val: Exhaustive coverage review found no independent architecture identity beyond an already modeled service.
reason_codes.unmodeled-architecture-candidate: Receivable provider declaration has independent architecture meaning but no honest accepted rule yet.
reason_codes.data-source-not-architecture-owner: Read-only lookup does not independently own architecture in this dialect.
reason_codes.ephemeral-input-not-architecture-owner: Ephemeral provider operation does not independently own persistent architecture.
reason_codes.provider-function-not-architecture: Provider function is expression behavior, not an architecture declaration.
reason_codes.resource-identity-protocol-metadata: Provider resource identity is protocol metadata, not a Terraform declaration.
reason_codes.catalog-supported: All matched architecture-owner surfaces have accepted semantics.
reason_codes.catalog-partial: Product has accepted architecture semantics plus supporting or unmodeled provider surface.
reason_codes.catalog-provider-surface-unmodeled: Product has receivable architecture-owner surface but no accepted semantic rule.
reason_codes.catalog-configuration-only: Matched provider surface is configuration or helper input without independent architecture identity.
reason_codes.no-provider-surface: Dated catalog product has no matching AzureRM or AzureAD baseline declaration surface.
reason_codes.no-bounded-provider-surface: Product may be reachable through generic ARM APIs, but no dated admitted type and API-version contract was proven.
